summary: Take Z from exists_intermediateGroup_lines and verify the six axioms of a sieve system for the normalised kernels: ψ(0) = 1; the step identities (the floor form at level i is the ψ-twisted integral of that at i + 1 — integral_floorForm_succ below the top, and at the top the integral of the top kernel averaged over L, via floorForm_top_eq_integral and Fubini); positive semidefiniteness and continuity of the top kernel; the bottom bound (floorZeroForm(Z) against floorZeroForm(K_T), the inequality of Z and the main-term bound for K_T); and the frequency bounds from enorm_floorForm_le with K = n⁶.

steps.claim: Take Z with the containment hm and the inequality hk: ϰ(Z)𝖬(K_T)(b^{6k})^{#Sg} ≤ ϰ(K_T)𝖬(Z).
steps.lean:
(hF.exists_intermediateGroup_lines Sg d).imp fun Z ⟨hm, hk⟩ ↦ by
  obtain ⟨n, _, _, Γ, C⟩ := S.pow_chain, S.k_le_f, S.one_le_b, hF.gauge, isCut_besselVector Z
  have N {x : ℂ} {D} d h : ‖x / Z.massRatio.toReal‖ ≤ _ :=
    (toReal_mono d (@ENNReal.div_le_of_le_mul' ‖x‖ₑ Z.massRatio D h)).trans' (by simp)
  have Er {j p q ξ ω} hj (k : IsUnit ξ) H : ‖F.floorForm j p q _ ω / _‖ ≤ S.frequencyGain T ξ * _ :=
    .trans' (by
    simp (disch := positivity) [-Nat.cast_mul, md_g, frequencyGain, finHeadWeight, -map_prod]
    gcongr _ * ?_ * _
    grw [g_le_b_pow, (by linarith [S.thousand_le_b] : 2 ≤ S.b), pow_add _ 6 3, mul_assoc, pow_mul',
      ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_succ']
    gcongr; grw [Shape.n, ← S.ϱ_le]; omega) (N (by simp [denomIndex_ne_zero, mul_eq_top,
    div_eq_top]) (IsStdLevel.enorm_floorForm_le (ξ := k.unit) Z _ hj (by omega) n.1 H))
  refine hF.psi_eq ▸ ⟨hm, fun L hl ↦ ⟨by simp, fun j p q ξ a ↦ ?_, by
    simp [div_eq_inv_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    exact fun a t e ↦ .smul (α := ℂ) ⟨.ext (by simp [topKernel, ← integral_conj, e]),
      fun x ↦ by simpa [x.sum_fintype, mul_right_comm] using!
      (lintegral_energy_le_topKernel Z _ L.2 (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_star_self
      x) e).1⟩ (by positivity), by simpa [div_div] using! (continuous_topKernel ..).div_const _,
    fun p q ↦ (N ofReal_ne_top ?_).trans_eq (toReal_ofReal (by positivity)), fun j p q a ↦
    (ite_eq_left a ▸ Er a · (.inr ⟨j, rfl, rfl, hF.g_eq ▸ (mul_sub ..).symm⟩))⟩⟩
  split_ifs with b <;> [simp_rw [div_eq_inv_mul] at *; simp_rw [← mul_div_assoc, integral_div]]
  exact (Γ.integral_floorForm_succ C ⟨j, b⟩ _ ξ (hF.lintegral_formMajorant_ne_top Z 0 a
    (by omega))).rec fun i s ↦ s.symm ▸ ⟨i, (by simp [·, Pi.one_def]), (Er a · (.inl rfl))⟩
  -- the top floor is the integral of the top kernel, up to the mean of ψ over L
  obtain ⟨rfl, ⟨i, e⟩, o⟩ := a.eq_of_not_lt' b, hF.1.floorForm_top_eq_integral Z p q ξ,
    L.2.measurableSet
  have ⟨I, s⟩ := integral_skew_product (volume.map_sub_left_eq_self <|
    (S.latMiddle _).frameGram ·⁻¹.1 𝔰.top 𝔰.top) (i.mul_prod (((by fun_prop : ContinuousOn
    (P.ψ <| -ξ * ·) L).integrableOn_compact hl).integrable_indicator o)) (by fun_prop [frameGram])
  refine (fun k ↦ ⟨((I.congr k).div_const _).div_const _, .symm ⟨fun u ↦ ?_, ?_⟩⟩)
    (P.ae_isUnit.mono fun | _, ⟨t, rfl⟩ => ?_)
  any_goals simp_rw [← integral_congr_ae k, s, integral_const_mul, integral_mul_const, ← e]
  grw [div_right_comm, mul_div_right_comm, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_integral_le_integral_norm,
    Er a u (by left; rfl)]
  iterate 2 simp +contextual [norm_indicator_eq_indicator_norm, o, Pi.one_def, finHeadWeight,
    Measure.real, toReal_eq_zero_iff, hl.measure_ne_top, L.2.measure_ne_zero _ ⟨0, L.zero_mem⟩]
  erw [topKernel, ← integral_indicator (o.preimage (by fun_prop [frameGram]))]
  simp [← integral_const_mul, Set.indicator, mul_sub, mul_right_comm _ _ (P.ψ _),
    ← P.ψ.map_add_eq_mul, correlation, Level.headDensity, prod_range, ne_of_lt]
  grw [ite_eq_left zero_le, ofReal_div_of_pos (by bound), IntermediateGroup.massRatio,
    ← ENNReal.mul_div_mul_comm, ENNReal.le_div_iff_mul_le (by simp; left; bound),
    ← ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left (P.unitaryLevel_open_compact.1.measure_ne_zero _ ?_)
    (hF.groupMeasure_ne_top le_rfl), ← mul_assoc, Level.enorm_floorForm_le, Level.headDensity,
    prod_range_zero, one_mul, lintegral_mul_const_le, (?_ : lintegral .. ≤ F.floorZeroForm
    Z), mul_right_comm, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by bound), ← hk.ge, floorZeroForm_le_main_term ⟨_,
    P.unitaryLevel_le_unitaryLevel_one, le_rfl⟩ 0 (by omega), sdiff_le, SemilocalField.volume_O,
    ← hF.box_eq.2.1, add_le_add_left hF.groupMeasure_boxSet_le, ← pow_six_le]
  any_goals simp [ENNReal.ofReal_add, pow_succ, add_assoc, ← mul_add, inv_two_add_inv_two, -inv_pow,
    mul_eq_top]
  ring; rfl
  simp [Level.floorZeroForm, enorm_integral_phase_eq_upperPairing, formModulus, descConv.eq_1,
    weylRatio, ← formIntegrandOne_eq Γ C, formIntegrandOne, ← sq, mul_pow]

    gcongr; grw [Shape.n, ← S.ϱ_le]; omega) (N (by simp [denomIndex_ne_zero, mul_eq_top,
    div_eq_top]) (IsStdLevel.enorm_floorForm_le (ξ := k.unit) Z _ hj (by omega) n.1 H))

steps.claim: The sieve system (with ψ = charOnPlaces = P.ψ by psi_eq): ψ(0) = 1; positive semidefiniteness of the top kernel matrix for a family with common ϱ-th term (it is conjugate-symmetric, and x*Mx = ∫ energy ≥ 0 by lintegral_energy_le_topKernel with R = xx*); continuity (continuous_topKernel divided by constants); the bottom bound (step 1.15); and the off-diagonal bound (Er with ω = 1, ξ = g⁻¹(p_i⁻¹ − q_i⁻¹), g_eq).
steps.lean:
refine hF.psi_eq ▸ ⟨hm, fun L hl ↦ ⟨by simp, fun j p q ξ a ↦ ?_, by
    simp [div_eq_inv_mul, ← mul_assoc]
    exact fun a t e ↦ .smul (α := ℂ) ⟨.ext (by simp [topKernel, ← integral_conj, e]),
      fun x ↦ by simpa [x.sum_fintype, mul_right_comm] using!
      (lintegral_energy_le_topKernel Z _ L.2 (Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_star_self
      x) e).1⟩ (by positivity), by simpa [div_div] using! (continuous_topKernel ..).div_const _,
    fun p q ↦ (N ofReal_ne_top ?_).trans_eq (toReal_ofReal (by positivity)), fun j p q a ↦
    (ite_eq_left a ▸ Er a · (.inr ⟨j, rfl, rfl, hF.g_eq ▸ (mul_sub ..).symm⟩))⟩⟩

steps.claim: The step identity at level i: split on whether i + 1 ≤ ϱ (then J(i+1) is a floor form; move the normalisation inside) or i = ϱ (then J(ϱ+1) is the top kernel; move the division by vol(L) inside the integral).
steps.lean: split_ifs with b <;> [simp_rw [div_eq_inv_mul] at *; simp_rw [← mul_div_assoc, integral_div]]

steps.claim: i + 1 ≤ ϱ: integral_floorForm_succ gives integrability and ∫ ψ(ξc)·floorForm(i+1, …) = floorForm(i, p, q, W, ψ(ξ·frameGram_{ii})); for ξ = 0 this is floorForm(i, p, q, W, 1), and for ξ a unit Er bounds it.
steps.lean:
exact (Γ.integral_floorForm_succ C ⟨j, b⟩ _ ξ (hF.lintegral_formMajorant_ne_top Z 0 a
    (by omega))).rec fun i s ↦ s.symm ▸ ⟨i, (by simp [·, Pi.one_def]), (Er a · (.inl rfl))⟩
  -- the top floor is the integral of the top kernel, up to the mean of ψ over L

steps.claim: i = ϱ (the top floor): floorForm(ϱ, p, q, W, φ_ξ) = ∫ φ_ξ(l⁻¹)⟪correlation(p, l), correlation(q, l)⟫ (floorForm_top_eq_integral), with integrability (i, e); L is measurable (o).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨rfl, ⟨i, e⟩, o⟩ := a.eq_of_not_lt' b, hF.1.floorForm_top_eq_integral Z p q ξ,
    L.2.measurableSet

steps.claim: Fubini for the skew product (l, c) ↦ (l, c − frameGram(l⁻¹)_top): ∫_c ψ(ξc)·(1/vol L)∫_{frameGram(l⁻¹)_top − c ∈ L} = ∫_l (1/vol L)∫_{c ∈ frameGram(l⁻¹)_top − L} ψ(ξc)·⟪…⟫ (translation invariance of the Haar measure).
steps.lean:
have ⟨I, s⟩ := integral_skew_product (volume.map_sub_left_eq_self <|
    (S.latMiddle _).frameGram ·⁻¹.1 𝔰.top 𝔰.top) (i.mul_prod (((by fun_prop : ContinuousOn
    (P.ψ <| -ξ * ·) L).integrableOn_compact hl).integrable_indicator o)) (by fun_prop [frameGram])

steps.claim: Integrability of c ↦ ψ(ξc)·J(ϱ+1, …), and the identity for ξ = 0 (the mean of ψ(0) = 1 over L is 1, giving floorForm(ϱ, p, q, W, 1)) and a.e. for unit ξ.

refine (fun k ↦ ⟨((I.congr k).div_const _).div_const _, .symm ⟨fun u ↦ ?_, ?_⟩⟩)

steps.claim: Rewrite with Fubini and pull the constants out of the integrals.
steps.lean: any_goals simp_rw [← integral_congr_ae k, s, integral_const_mul, integral_mul_const, ← e]

steps.claim: For a unit ξ: |∫| ≤ ∫|·| and the average of ψ(ξ·) over a translate of L has modulus ≤ 1, so the bound follows from Er (first alternative).
steps.lean:
grw [div_right_comm, mul_div_right_comm, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_integral_le_integral_norm,
    Er a u (by left; rfl)]

steps.claim: Simplify norms of indicators and measures (L compact with vol(L) ≠ 0, ∞).
steps.lean:

steps.claim: Write the top kernel as an integral of an indicator (topKernel, integral_indicator).
Expand the correlations and the head density, and combine ψ(a)ψ(b) = ψ(a + b).
steps.lean:

steps.claim: The bottom bound ‖J(0, p, q)‖ ≤ (1 + b⁻⁶)/(b^{6k})^{#Sg}: ‖floorForm(0)‖ ≤ ∫ formModulus ≤ ϰ(Z) (Level.enorm_floorForm_le, headDensity at 0 is the empty product 1; the side goal of step 1.18); massRatio(Z) = 𝖬(Z)𝖬(K(g))/unipotentMass²; then hk: ϰ(Z)(b^{6k})^{#Sg} ≤ ϰ(K_T)𝖬(Z)/𝖬(K_T), and ϰ(K_T) ≤ 𝖬(K_T)𝖬(K(g))(𝖬(K_T) + vol(R∖R^×)·2^{−n}) (floorZeroForm_le_main_term, t = 0), vol(R∖R^×) ≤ vol(R) = 1, 𝖬(K_T) = 𝖬(box) ≤ 1 + 2^{−n} (box_eq, groupMeasure_boxSet_le), and 2^{−ϱ} ≤ b⁻⁶ (pow_six_le).
steps.lean:

    prod_range_zero, one_mul, lintegral_mul_const_le, (?_ : lintegral .. ≤ F.floorZeroForm
    Z), mul_right_comm, ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by bound), ← hk.ge, floorZeroForm_le_main_term ⟨_,
